newsitem.title: UKRAINE: SOCCER-UKRAINE DASH N.IRISH HOPES WITH 2-1 WIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-UKRAINE DASH N.IRISH HOPES WITH 2-1 WIN.

text.p: Andrei Shevchenko's 71st-minute strike virtually put an end to Northern Ireland's hopes of reaching the World Cup finals for the first time since 1986 and gave Ukraine a 2-1 victory on Wednesday.

Ukraine jumped to the top of qualifying group nine with 12 points from five games, three points clear of second-placed Portugal with a game in hand. Group favourites Germany, playing Albania later on Wednesday, lurk behind with games in hand.
Vitaly Kosovsky opened the scoring in Kiev in the third minute, surprising the Irish with a quickly taken shot into the top far corner.
The visitors equalised 12 minutes later when Oleg Luzhny handled inside the area and Iain Dowie scored from the spot.

But a stirring second-half rally by the hosts, stirred on by a partisan 75,000 crowd, sewed confusion among the Irish defence allowing Yuri Kalytvintsov to find Shevchenko unmarked in front of goal. He calmly beat Tommy Wright from close range.

Ukraine - 1-Olexander Kosovsky, 2-Oleg Luzhny, 3-Sergiy Bejenar, 4-Alexander Golovko, 5-Viktor Skrypnyk, 6-Dmitro Mykhailenko, 7-Vasyl Kardash, 8-Yuri Kalitvintsev (15-Valery Kriventsov 86), 9-Vitaly Kosovsky (13-Hennady Orbu 72), 10-Andriy Shevchenko, 11-Sergiy Rebrov

Northern Ireland - 1-Tommy Wright, 2-Ian Nolan, 3-Stephen Morrow, 4-Colin Hill, 5-Gerry Taggart, 6-Stephen Lomas, 7-Keith Gillespie (18-Gerald Mcmahon 79), 8-Kevin Horlock, 9-Iain Dowie, 10-Neil Lennon (17-Quinn James 76), 11-Michael Hughes
